Batch scrape with aggressive preprocessing configuration

```rust title="Rust"
use crawlberg::batch_scrape;
use crawlberg::CrawlConfig;
use crawlberg::create_engine;

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() {
    let engine_config: CrawlConfig = serde_json::from_str("{\"content\":{\"preprocessing_preset\":\"aggressive\"}}").expect("config should parse");
    let engine = create_engine(Some(engine_config)).expect("handle creation should succeed");
    let urls: Vec<String> = [r#"https://example.com/article1"#, r#"https://example.com/article2"#].into_iter().map(str::to_string).collect();
    let result = batch_scrape(&engine, urls).await;
    println!("{:?}", result);
}
```
